text:
Introduction
The condenser tube 
cleaning system (taprogge) function a voidance of fouling and scaling in tubes 
during operation of condenser constant heat transfer coefficient in condenser 
and heat exchanger reduction of heat consumption elimination of corrosion due to 
the reduction of micro - organism in tubes
This document outline the equipment 
inspection (II) to be performed every six months as indicated by (M6) in above 
title block
The first draft initiated by eng. 
Mahmoud Abou Elfetouh Shata tested by eng. Ali Abd El slam and revised by MDEPC 
quality control engineer Abouda Elbana acepted by general director eng. Yosry 
Abd Elmaqsood and approved by eng. Farouk Awad head sector of Talkha power 
station. This document accepted by eng Samer Abd ElGilil MDEPC inspection & 
quality control general director MPIS coordinator & certified by eng.Mohamed Nageb MDEPC inspection and quality control head sector.
Identification
Safety 
Precautions
Issue work order including the team work names
Wear safety helmets - shoes - gloves, etc
Use safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area
Isolate the circuit breaker of the pump motor
Disconnect electric terminal of the pump motor
The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction 
 valves
Tools and 
Equipment
Complete maintenance tool 
 set
Cleaning fluid
Feeler gauge & dial 
 indicator
Rages
Work to be carried out
Check discharge and pump pressure 
 then compare it with the setting value and replace the worn - out components 
 (if it is needed)
Check alignment and compare it with the setting value and record it
Make test for bearings oil and add or change it (if it is needed)
Check flanges for water leakage
Check bolts fixation then re-tightens (if it is needed)
Check glands for water leakage and re-pack (if it is needed)
Check the pump casing against rust and re-paint it
Account the cleaning ball and record it
